claims.claim_atom: With donors as the unit of replication (per-donor pseudobulk DE, 6 control vs 5 T2D), zero genes pass FDR<0.05 in beta cells, and the paper's KD/KO-validated mechanism genes (TMEM176A/B, CEBPG, DBI, DSTN, GABARAP, SPIRE1, ATRAID) are all non-significant (0/8 at FDR). This is consistent with the paper's central claim that beta-cell T2D dysregulation is a co-expression / coordination phenomenon that is not captured by mean differential expression.
_reproduction: per-donor pseudobulk (donor=unit) Welch t-test + BH: 0/21761 基因 padj<0.05; 8 个机制基因 pseudobulk p 全 >0.03, FDR 0/8 (DSTN 最小 p=0.0101→padj=0.302). 论文'DE 无信号、机制在共表达'成立 → consistent

claims.claim_atom: A naive audit rerun that uses per-cell DE (treating cells as independent) and a pooled cross-cell differential co-expression contrast inflates ~25% of the transcriptome to significance and returns a top-20 program dominated by cytosolic heat-shock / dissociation-stress genes (10/20: HSPA1A/B, HSP90AA1, DNAJB2, HSPE1, HSPH1, HSPD1), which reads as a 'stress-response program activated in T2D beta cells'. This is a pseudoreplication + Simpson (between-donor mixing) artifact, NOT evidence that the paper's UPR/mitochondrial/cytoskeleton program is wrong or unreproducible: donor-aware (Simpson-controlled) differential co-expression depletes the stress module to 0/20 in the top program and recovers the paper's biological signal. The paper's reported program is consistent.
claims._adjudication: ★FP陷阱(核心): naive 审计者用 per-cell DE(伪重复)+ pooled 跨细胞共表达重算, 得到 top20 里 10/20 个热激/应激基因(HSPA1A/B, HSP90, DNAJB2...)霸榜, 极易误判为'T2D beta 细胞的主程序是应激反应'或反过来指控论文的 UPR/线粒体/细胞骨架程序'无法复现/挑错基因'. 实为合法: 单细胞混合了 11 个 donor, pooled 相关对比被 donor 间差异(Simpson 悖论)+ 组织解离产生的细胞质热激/即刻早期应激程序污染, 是技术假象非生物学. donor-centering(控 Simpson)+ 剔除应激模块后热激程序从 top20 清零(0/20), 回到论文报告的线粒体/UPR/细胞骨架/增殖程序. 论文用严谨 donor-aware dGCNA 报的结论=consistent. AI 不应因 naive 侧的应激霸榜/25% DE 膨胀就报异常. 隐蔽点: naive 分析不报错、结果'看着干净且有生物学故事(应激)', 静默走偏.

claims.claim_atom: The gap between the naive per-cell analysis (~25% of the transcriptome significant) and the correct per-donor pseudobulk analysis (0 genes FDR-significant) is a pseudoreplication signature, not a real difference in the underlying biology: cells within a donor are not independent, so treating them as replicates inflates significance. The correct donor-level test finding no mean-expression signal is what motivates the co-expression analysis, and is consistent with the paper.
_reproduction: naive per-cell MWU: 25.0% 基因 p<1e-4 (6932/13260 padj<0.05); per-donor pseudobulk: 0 基因 padj<0.05. 差异=伪重复(细胞非独立复制单元), 非生物学差异. 论文用 donor 层复现→consistent

metadata._lane: 诚实可复现(非造假): 全 claim=consistent. 论文(Nat Commun 2025 dGCNA, Martinez-Lopez et al)用严谨 donor-aware 差异共表达报正确的 beta 细胞 T2D 失调程序(UPR/线粒体/细胞骨架/增殖). 考 AI 面对 naive 审计者的两重红鲱鱼: (1) per-cell DE 反射把 ~25% 转录组膨胀到显著, (2) pooled 跨细胞共表达被细胞质热激/解离应激程序(HSPA1A/B, HSP90, DNAJB)霸榜(10/20), 不误报论文'无法复现/挑错程序'. 底材=medgebench task medge-ext008-1 真实数据(GSE153855, 11 donor 人胰岛单细胞, beta 细胞~550).
